codes.name: A
codes.description: As soon as possible (a priority lower than stat)

codes.name: B
codes.description: Do at bedside or portable (may be used with other codes)

codes.name: C
codes.description: Measure continuously (e.g., arterial line blood pressure)

codes.name: P
codes.description: Preoperative (to be done prior to surgery)

codes.name: T
codes.description: Timing critical (do as near as possible to requested time)
